original_review_reason: عقبة = obstacle; target عتبة بن غزوان (companion)
revert_reason: GT contradiction: GT verse 301 spells عُقْبَة with ق (the OCR's own letter), and p44 l18-l28 map one-to-one onto GT verses 298-304 (l18->298, l21->299, l22->300, l25->301, l26->302, l27->303, l28->304), so the verse identity is airtight. The manuscript reads ابن عُقْبَة المَريد — a proper name, not the common noun 'obstacle' the original review note assumed. The correction to عتبة was wrong and is reverted. p76 re-judged separately in Task 2.

Context contradiction (Task 3 audit, no GT coverage at these pages): the manuscript reads 'السوادين فمن كوش بن حام' — the dark-skinned peoples descend from Kush son of HAM (حام), not Shem (سام). Three signals: (1) the same verse appears twice in the corpus, both reading حام (p16 l18 prose, p110 l9 verse); (2) the next verse (p110 l10) names حام again: 'نوح على الفلك وحذر الرجال من النساء، في حام وصال'; (3) Shem (سام) is the ancestor of the Semites in this tradition, never of السوادين. The vault's skeleton سام is Adnan's ancestor — the wrong person for this verse. The OCR's حام was correct.
